title: inverted pyramid no welcome filler
name: Inverted pyramid no welcome filler — Canada.ca
rule: Inverted pyramid; no welcome-message filler. Most important idea/step first; then prioritized tasks; extra detail last and only if it supports the task. Stay on topic; no “welcome to our site” or background for its own sake.

citation.source: Canada.ca — Designing content; Content Style Guide

pass_when: Lead is the main idea/step; extra detail is last and task-supporting; no welcome/background filler.
fail_when: Welcome-to-our-site opener, or background before the task.
overview: Lead with the main idea or step; skip welcome and background filler.
apply_when: Opening Canada.ca page copy for a task people need to complete.
not_when: Required legal notices that must appear before a regulated action.
agent_hint: Put the main idea first; park extra detail last; drop welcome-to-our-site openers.
description: Canada.ca uses an inverted pyramid: most important idea or step first, then prioritized tasks, with extra detail last and only if it supports the task. Stay on topic; skip “welcome to our site” and background written for its own sake. Apply when opening page copy for a task people need to complete. Fail a welcome-to-our-site opener, or background that appears before the task they came to do.
do_not_claim: Four writing qualities as this structure row.
